doc.title: Annie Ross interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001

title: Joe Williams and the Basie band recording
summary: Joe Williams sang the melody and they rehearsed under a Philadelphia stage before performing with the Basie band; she mentions skipping two octaves on 'Airegin'.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Joe Williams: the singer with Basie

blocks.x: I’ll bet Joe Williams liked this. And he added, what was his assignment when you did the next one? He did some of the lower parts?
Not really. Joe sang the melody.

I remember rehearsing under the stage of the theater, I think it was in Philly. And we rehearsed down there and then we went up and did it because it was with the Basie band. © Fillius Jazz Archive -10-
Oh gosh, that’s a riot. Those are some tricky notes to find, too, I think, don’t you think so?
Well no, because it was all very natural. I heard a thing the other day that someone had that I saw. It was “Airegin.” You know the song “Airegin?”
And that is quite something because I’d skip two octaves. [scats] Way up there. And I said oh my, wow.
